node.title: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free pre-HMR startup failure classification and terminalization recovery

notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority permits the provider-disabled recovery only.
The accepted path launches no native Harness, worker or provider request.
Any new occupied native worker remains a distinct Yuri decision.

decisions.summary: Accept two startup stages, eleven fail-closed causes, fixed byte signatures, ambiguity, unclassified and stream-limit outcomes.
Accept exclusive safe sidecar validation before exact-root removal and digest-only ordinary-terminal binding.
Accept twelve semantic scenarios, twelve hostile mutations, forty-nine focused tests, five ordering assertions and seventeen immutable artifacts.
Reject attempt-002 reclassification, Harness reliability, DeepSeek performance and any occupied retry or provider authority.
Accept AER-0716 through AER-0721 as contained, including the ready-only local broker test boundary breach with exact post-test absence.

claim_scope: Future native-Harness failures before the first HMR event can emit a bounded sanitized stage and cause before raw stream deletion.
Raw startup lines, paths, exception messages, prompts, reasoning, environment values and credentials are not durable terminal fields.
Zero matching cause groups remain unclassified and multiple groups remain ambiguous.
Streams above sixty-four KiB per stream receive only the closed stream-limit cause while full counts and digests are retained.
The accepted provider-disabled path starts no native Harness, worker or provider request.
Attempt 002 remains immutable and its exact semantic startup cause remains unproved.
unresolved_gates: Attempt 002's exact semantic startup cause remains unproved and cannot be reconstructed.
Harness reliability and DeepSeek coding performance remain unproved.
A new occupied native worker requires Yuri's distinct decision.
No product, data, database, ordinary-practice, production, deployment, Pages or protected integration is open.

baton_acceptance.label: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free pre-HMR startup terminal recovery acceptance

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Continuation receipts must use the exact configured continuation-event vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preplanning runtime state supplied pre_plan instead of pre_sprint_planning and was rejected before source change.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with continuation_event_missing_or_unapproved.

correction.action: List the configured event vocabulary and regenerate the receipt with pre_sprint_planning.
correction.prevention_control: Continuation events are selected from orchestrator preflight list output rather than recalled aliases.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected pre_plan alias and the schema-listed pre_sprint_planning correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Exact Git identities belong only to the machine-generated snapshot, not narrative five-source evidence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first post-compaction runtime state repeated full Git object IDs in git_refs_and_worktree prose.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Preflight rejected with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden before implementation resumed.

correction.action: Remove all exact object IDs from narrative Git evidence and delegate them to the machine snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: The Git evidence sentence now contains no hexadecimal object literal and the guard remains mandatory.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected manual Git-object narrative recurrence and corrected machine-only projection.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Exact controller timeout coordinates must validate without requiring a raw-text signature.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first validator treated hmr_bootstrap_failed only as signature-derived and rejected a native_worker_timeout terminal with no matched signature group.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused timeout fixture failed at single_signature_cause_invalid before any candidate acceptance.

correction.action: Validate controller timeout and exception facts separately from nonzero-exit signature classification.
correction.prevention_control: The relationship matrix now has exact fixtures for process creation, timeout, controller exception and text-derived exits.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the timeout relationship defect and exact controller-fact validation repair.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A repository script must boot both as a direct path and through module import from the repository root.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Two direct build/check invocations failed before evidence generation because orchestration_harness was imported before repository-root bootstrapping.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Python returned ModuleNotFoundError for orchestration_harness on both invocations.

correction.action: Add the standard bounded repository-root bootstrap before local package imports.
correction.prevention_control: Both direct --build and --check invocations are part of the accepted command manifest.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the direct-script import failure and standard repository-root bootstrap.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Deterministic controller-ordering probes must bind the current stable source seam after a refactor.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first per-label stream-read refactor left the probe searching for the earlier literal stdout call, so evidence build and two tests rejected.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The builder and tests raised ValueError because the stale source substring was absent.

correction.action: Bind the ordering probe to the stable per-label stream-reading assignment.
correction.prevention_control: The builder and focused test share the same stable ordering seam and all five assertions pass.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the stale source-order probe and its stable per-label binding repair.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The provider-disabled recovery validation must not start a broker, native Harness, worker or provider request.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first broad test selection included the historical local broker-ready regression and briefly started one test broker outside the tranche boundary.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Review of the selected legacy test source exposed its Popen call; its finally block terminated the broker and exact post-test readback found zero matching processes and no attempt root.

correction.action: Narrow the accepted manifest to the recovery suite and make subprocess Popen and run fatal within provider-disabled validation.
correction.prevention_control: The accepted forty-nine-test suite monkeypatches both subprocess entry points and the evidence boundary remains zero process and zero provider request.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the ready-only local broker test breach, exact absence and narrowed fatal-subprocess validation manifest.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every clockwork Python command must use the schema-owned module-launch form beginning with -m.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first closeout check supplied the recovery evidence runner as a direct script path and was rejected before canonical mutation.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork validator returned tick_command_contract before preparing a generation.

correction.action: Replace the direct script operand with -m followed by the exact module path.
correction.prevention_control: Closeout command manifests are checked against the exact clockwork module-launch contract before publication.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected direct-script closeout command and corrected module-launch form.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Continuity contract evidence must use typed contract objects rather than bare repository paths.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second closeout check supplied four bare contract-evidence paths and prospective graph validation rejected them.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Clockwork transaction preparation returned contract_evidence_object_required before canonical mutation.

correction.action: Project the four paths through one satisfied typed contract-evidence object.
correction.prevention_control: New node contract evidence follows the continuity graph contractEvidence definition before transaction preparation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected bare contract paths and corrected typed contract-evidence object.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A nonempty contract-evidence record must reference an existing global continuity contract and its registered node evidence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The third closeout check used a newly invented local contract ID as though it were a registered global cross-node contract.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Prospective validation returned contract_evidence_contract_unknown and path_not_node_evidence before canonical mutation.

correction.action: Set cross-node contract evidence empty and retain the tranche-local contract under ordinary node evidence.
correction.prevention_control: Nonempty contract evidence is admitted only after resolving an existing ID from the continuity graph contract registry.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected invented global contract ID and empty cross-node contract projection.
